bank.q: Which of the following parenthetical in-text citations correctly follows APA 7th edition for a paper by two authors?
bank.hint: Check which conjunction symbol is required inside parentheses.
bank.explanation: In APA 7th parenthetical citations, multiple authors are joined by an ampersand (&). The word 'and' is reserved for running narrative text.

bank.q: Under APA 7th guidelines, how should a study written by four authors (Khan, Ahmed, Malik, and Tariq, published in 2021) be cited the very FIRST time it appears in your thesis?
bank.hint: Recall the major simplification introduced in the 7th edition for 3 or more authors.
bank.explanation: Under APA 7th, any publication with 3 or more authors is truncated to the first author plus 'et al.' from the very first citation.

bank.q: True or False: In APA 7th style, it is acceptable to use an ampersand (&) in narrative running text (e.g., 'As Bass & Avolio (2020) demonstrated...').
options: True — the ampersand can be used interchangeably in narrative and parenthetical text.
False — the word 'and' must be spelled out in running narrative text.
bank.hint: Check the rule for narrative citations.
bank.explanation: False. In running text, the word 'and' must always be spelled out. The ampersand (&) is strictly reserved for parenthetical citations, tables, and reference lists.

bank.q: What is the threshold word count at which a direct quotation must be converted into a freestanding, indented block quotation without quotation marks?
bank.hint: Recall the 40-word boundary rule in APA 7th.
bank.explanation: In APA 7th, quotations of 40 words or more must be formatted as block quotes: indented 0.5 inches from the left margin with zero quotation marks.

bank.q: When citing multiple independent sources within the same set of parentheses, how must they be arranged?
options: Chronologically from oldest publication year to newest.
Alphabetically by the first author's surname, separated by semicolons.
In order of importance to your research argument.
Grouped by whether they agree or disagree with your hypothesis.
bank.hint: Remember that APA prioritizes alphabetical searchability for examiners.
bank.explanation: Multiple works within the same parenthetical citation must be ordered alphabetically by the first author's surname, separated by semicolons: (Ahmed, 2019; Bilal, 2021; Zafar, 2015).

bank.q: True or False: Every single in-text citation in your thesis must have a matching entry in your reference list, and every entry in your reference list must be cited in your text.
options: True — complete bi-directional correspondence is required in academic dissertations.
False — you can list background books in your reference list that were never cited in your text.
bank.hint: Consider the difference between a bibliography (reading list) and an APA reference list.
bank.explanation: True. An APA reference list must contain only and all sources cited in the body of the paper. Uncited background sources are prohibited in APA reference lists.
